2607.01021.title: PedNStream: Scalable Network Flow Simulation for Pedestrian Traffic Management
2607.01021.paper_summary: Large-scale crowd management requires pedestrian simulations that are both computationally efficient and compatible with feedback-based control. However, most open-source tools are either microscopic or not designed for network-scale closed-loop evaluation. This paper presents PedNStream (Pedestrian Network Flow Simulation), an open-source, Python-native simulator for macroscopic pedestrian network loading based on the Link Transmission Model (LTM). The framework extends LTM-based pedestrian models by incorporating stochastic link dynamics that capture diffusion and activity-induced variability, and replaces dynamic user equilibrium route choice with a utility-based formulation suited to uncertain, intervention-driven settings. PedNStream is implemented as a modular framework with built-in controller interfaces for interventions such as gating, flow separation, and route guidance. We evaluate the framework in a staged manner. Synthetic scenarios verify key mechanisms, including queue formation, spillback, congestion dissipation, and adaptive rerouting. Real-network experiments assess large-scale behavior and consistency with observed pedestrian counts. A closed-loop case study demonstrates controller integration, and a runtime analysis quantifies scalability. These results establish PedNStream as an efficient and practical testbed for large-scale pedestrian network simulation and control.
2607.01021.paper_summary_zh: 大型人群管理需要計算效率高且與基於反饋的控制相容的行人模擬。然而，大多數開源工具要麼是微觀的，要麼不適合網絡規模的閉環評估。本文介紹了PedNStream（行人網絡流模擬），這是一個基於鏈接傳輸模型（LTM）的開源Python本地模擬器，用於宏觀行人網絡負載。該框架通過納入捕捉擴散和活動引起的變異性的隨機鏈接動態，擴展了基於LTM的行人模型，並用適合不確定性和干預驅動環境的效用基礎公式替換了動態用戶均衡路徑選擇。PedNStream作為一個模塊化框架實現，內置控制器接口以進行如閘口、流量分離和路徑指導等干預。我們以分階段的方式評估該框架。合成場景驗證了包括排隊形成、溢出、擁堵消散和自適應重新路由等關鍵機制。真實網絡實驗評估了大規模行為及其與觀察到的行人數量的一致性。一個閉環案例研究展示了控制器集成，並且運行時分析量化了可擴展性。這些結果確立了PedNStream作為大型行人網絡模擬和控制的高效實用測試平台。
